adaptation: Preserve lease/fencing, receipt replay and atomic event contracts; implement synchronous SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE/CAS instead of Prisma/PostgreSQL. Domain effects join the same DB transaction. General command persistence also follows protocol.ts documented in research report 01. Invocation ownership, exact replay before budget, SENT/UNKNOWN and attempts follow the model invocation source. The target uses owner step/run + frozen input revision and local SQLite evidence; no source Prisma billing, owner-kind catalog, encrypted TTL replay or SDK transport is copied. Durable handoff freezes ownership, releases coordinator lease and uses independent child step lease plus parent control/input fences. Domain commit/receipt precedes an explicit scheduler acknowledgement; a crash in that gap replays the receipt, never the effect. Complete+parent wake+event share one SQLite transaction.
limitations: Durable child leases and exact child model wait/reconciliation are implemented. Complete Goal/Turn orchestration, external prompt supersession and production transport remain future stages. Context guards are integrated in the isolated script host; production composition root is not yet switched.
